        function cat(e) {

        }

        function std_mean(e) {

            n = arguments.length > 2 && void 0 !== arguments[2] ? arguments[2] : 1,
            r = arguments.length > 3 && void 0 !== arguments[3] && arguments[3];

        }

        function mean(e) {

            n = arguments.length > 2 && void 0 !== arguments[2] && arguments[2];

              return e + t

        function dynamicTimeWarping(e) {

            n = t[0],

            for (var u = 1; u < n + 1; ++u) {

                break;

        function hanning(e) {
          if (e < 1) return new Float64Array;
          if (1 === e) return new Float64Array([1]);
          for (var t = e - 1, n = Math.PI / t, r = new Float64Array(e), a = 0; a < e; ++a) {
            var i = 2 * a - t;
            r[a] = .5 + .5 * Math.cos(n * i)
          }
          return r
        }
        var HERTZ_TO_MEL_MAPPING = {
          htk: function(e) {
            return 2595 * Math.log10(1 + e / 700)
          },
          kaldi: function(e) {
            return 1127 * Math.log(1 + e / 700)
          },
          slaney: function(e) {
            var t = arguments.length > 1 && void 0 !== arguments[1] ? arguments[1] : 1e3,
              n = arguments.length > 2 && void 0 !== arguments[2] ? arguments[2] : 15,
              r = arguments.length > 3 && void 0 !== arguments[3] ? arguments[3] : 27 / Math.log(6.4);
            return e >= t ? n + Math.log(e / t) * r : 3 * e / 200
          }
        };

        function hertz_to_mel(e) {
          var t = HERTZ_TO_MEL_MAPPING[arguments.length > 1 && void 0 !== arguments[1] ? arguments[1] : "htk"];

          })
        }
        var MEL_TO_HERTZ_MAPPING = {
          htk: function(e) {
            return 700 * (Math.pow(10, e / 2595) - 1)
          },
          kaldi: function(e) {
            return 700 * (Math.exp(e / 1127) - 1)
          },
          slaney: function(e) {
            var t = arguments.length > 1 && void 0 !== arguments[1] ? arguments[1] : 1e3,
              n = arguments.length > 2 && void 0 !== arguments[2] ? arguments[2] : 15,
              r = arguments.length > 3 && void 0 !== arguments[3] ? arguments[3] : Math.log(6.4) / 27;
            return e >= n ? t * Math.exp(r * (e - n)) : 200 * e / 3
          }
        };

        function mel_to_hertz(e) {
          var t = MEL_TO_HERTZ_MAPPING[arguments.length > 1 && void 0 !== arguments[1] ? arguments[1] : "htk"];

        function _create_triangular_filter_bank(e, t) {
          for (var n = Float64Array.from({
              length: t.length - 1
            }, function(e, n) {
              return t[n + 1] - t[n]
            }), r = Array.from({
              length: e.length

              return new Array(t.length)
            }), a = 0; a < e.length; ++a)
            for (var i = r[a], o = 0; o < t.length; ++o) i[o] = t[o] - e[a];
          for (var s = t.length - 2, u = Array.from({
              length: s

                d = l[f + 2] / n[f + 1];

            }

        }

        function padReflect(e, t, n) {

        function _db_conversion_helper(e, t, n, r, a) {
